methodology.reference: app/lib/programmeFlexibility.ts on branch chatgpt/programmes-batch4-2026-11-28 (commit be2db3a1) and audits/PROGRAMME_FLEXIBILITY_HANDOFF_2026-11-27.md
methodology.scale: Each axis 0, 0.5 or 1; stars only when all five axes are sourced; an unassessed axis is null, never a default.

rubric.drawdown: static 1; end-of-day trailing 0.5; intraday/equity or closed-balance trailing 0
rubric.payout: unrestricted access with ordinary timing <=14 days 1; moderate delay, gate or cap 0.5; severe caps or forfeiture 0
rubric.consistency: no rule 1; >=30% delaying (not forfeiting) payouts 0.5; lower than 30% or forfeiture 0
rubric.trading: broad ordinary permissions 1; material restrictions 0.5; severe restrictions 0
rubric.funded: ordinary objectives/KYC only 1; material extra conditions 0.5; permanent payout loss or hard termination rules beyond the loss limits 0

scopeRules: Funded-stage rules only; evaluation rules are listed under evaluationRulesExcluded and never scored.
Default payout route is rated; other funded routes, purchase options and old versions are separate variants with overrides.
A rule is placed on one axis only (no double penalty).
Unresolved contradictions between official sources leave the axis null; a resolution, when proposed, is recorded in resolvedConflict for the reviewer.
Official sources only (firm FAQ, rules pages, product pages, terms, change logs); third-party sites used only to locate pages.

programmes.name: High Stakes (2-Step) — Pro account
programmes.scope: High Stakes Pro stage after the New (10%/5%) or Classic (8%/5%) evaluation; product page read 28 Nov 2026 (New tab displayed; Classic tab not rendered in the capture). Funded rules are shared by both entry tiers.
programmes.scopeFr: Compte Pro High Stakes après l'évaluation New (10 %/5 %) ou Classic (8 %/5 %) ; règles financées communes.

drawdown.reason: 10% maximum loss from the initial balance; the drawdown FAQ example fixes the equity stop-out at $4,500 on a $5,000 account while the allowance grows with retained profit (absolute floor, not trailing).

payout.reason: Bi-weekly payouts on the Pro account, capped at $3,000 (50K) and $4,000 (100K) per payout with minimum P&L of $300/$500; crypto withdrawals limited to $1,500 per transaction (FAQ updated 24 Nov 2026).

consistency.reason: Unresolved: the High Stakes page, general rules FAQ (3 Nov) and payout FAQ (24 Nov) list no consistency rule; the consistency FAQ (30 Oct) says the percentage depends on account type or region without naming programmes; an official blog (Sep 2026) states a 50% funded-only rule for High Stakes; the 2-Step Plan FAQ (2 Nov) states 50% on the Pro account but for a $100K plan priced $149/$179 with 3% daily loss, which does not match High Stakes ($545, 5% daily).

trading.reason: Executing any order from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after high-impact news is prohibited; profits are deducted and losses kept. Overnight and weekend holding allowed.

funded.reason: Pro account keeps the 5% maximum daily loss; three profitable days (>=0.5% of initial balance) are required for each scale-up; Pro accounts expire after 60 consecutive days of inactivity.

programmes.comparisonWithBatch4: Same drawdown 1, payout 0.5, trading 0.5. Adds funded 0.5. Consistency still not assessed.

programmes.name: 2-Step Plan ($100K New $149 / Classic $179) — Pro account

drawdown.reason: Maximum loss 10% of the initial balance (evaluation risk model; the FAQ does not give a different funded figure).

payout.reason: Payout cap $2,000 per cycle and $250 minimum PnL are stated, but the cycle length is not; cannot tell moderate from severe.

consistency.reason: 50% consistency on the Pro account only; the consistency FAQ says exceeding it delays payout or scale-up and does not fail the account.

trading.reason: News, weekend and EA rules for this plan are not stated on its FAQ.

funded.reason: Funded-stage conditions beyond consistency and payout cap are not stated.

programmes.note: Possibly a regional or partner variant; confirm with The5ers before adding to the catalogue.

programmes.name: Bootcamp (3-Step) — Pro account
programmes.scope: Bootcamp Pro stage ($20K/$100K/$250K start); programme FAQ updated 2 Nov 2026; product page read 28 Nov 2026.
programmes.scopeFr: Compte Pro Bootcamp (départ 20K/100K/250K) ; FAQ du 2 novembre 2026.

drawdown.reason: Pro maximum loss 4% of the account balance at each level (scaling table). The drawdown FAQ (22 Jul 2026) defines the equity stop-out as a fixed floor from the initial balance whose allowance grows with retained profit (Bootcamp example: floor $9,500 stays while profit rises).
drawdown.resolvedConflict: Batch 4 left this axis open because an official blog (Sep 2026) calls the Bootcamp limit "trailing with retained profit". The dedicated rules FAQ with a numerical example is preferred to educational blog text; the same blogs also claim a mandatory stop loss that the stop-loss FAQ explicitly denies. Reviewer may keep the axis open if this reading is not accepted.

payout.reason: First payout 14 days after receiving the Pro account, then every 2 weeks; the 14-day cycle restarts every time the account scales.

consistency.reason: Official article states Bootcamp has no published percentage-based consistency rule; programme FAQ and product page list none.

trading.reason: News trading allowed except bracketing strategies; overnight and weekend holding allowed (index swaps high). No mandatory stop loss on any The5ers programme, Bootcamp included.

funded.reason: Remaining fee paid to activate the Pro account; 3% daily pause on Pro (trading resumes next day); each active account must use a different trading method; closure after 30 days of inactivity.

programmes.comparisonWithBatch4: Same payout 0.5, consistency 1, trading 1, funded 0.5. Adds drawdown 1 (see resolvedConflict) → 4.0/5.

programmes.name: Hyper Growth (1-Step) — Pro account
programmes.scope: Hyper Growth Pro stages; programme FAQ updated 2 Nov 2026; Growth product page read 28 Nov 2026 (Hyper Growth tab).
programmes.scopeFr: Comptes Pro Hyper Growth ; FAQ du 2 novembre 2026.

drawdown.reason: Accounts that hit the stop-out are terminated; the stop-out is 6% below the initial account size. The drawdown FAQ example keeps the floor at $9,400 on a $10,000 account as profit grows.
drawdown.resolvedConflict: Same blog wording ("6 percent, trailing with retained profit") as for Bootcamp; programme FAQ and drawdown FAQ both describe a fixed floor below the initial size.

payout.reason: First payout 14 days after receiving a Pro account, then every 2 weeks; the cycle resets each time the account scales.

consistency.reason: Official article states Hyper Growth has no published percentage-based consistency rule; programme FAQ and product page list none.

trading.reason: News trading allowed except bracket strategies; weekend holding allowed; leverage 1:30.

funded.reason: 3% daily pause disables the account for the rest of the day without termination; same target and loss rules at each Pro stage; accounts inactive for more than 30 consecutive days expire; $40,000 evaluation capital cap per trader.

programmes.comparisonWithBatch4: Not in batch 4. Claude PR #309 rated 4 axes and left consistency open; consistency now rated 1 on the same basis batch 4 used for Bootcamp → 4.0/5.

programmes.name: Pro Growth (1-Step) — Pro account

programmes.name: 1-Step Express — FT+ Trader account
programmes.scope: Help article last updated 08.12.2026 (format of the help centre); funded FT+ Trader simulated live account.
programmes.scopeFr: Compte FT+ Trader du 1-Step Express ; article mis à jour le 08.12.2026.

drawdown.reason: 6% maximum loss trailing the closed-balance high watermark until it reaches the initial balance (balance-based relative trailing).

payout.reason: Withdrawal as soon as the account is in profit, from day 1, minimum $50, then every 7 days; 80% split.

consistency.reason: The dedicated Consistency Rule article lists only the 2-Step Classic (35% evaluation / 50% funded); the Express article lists its rules without any consistency requirement.

trading.reason: Overnight and weekend holding allowed; no stop-loss requirement; news trading allowed (Risk Review Policy), with margin-utilisation review triggers rather than hard limits.

funded.reason: 4% daily drawdown on the prior closed balance remains a hard limit; 30-day inactivity is a hard breach; scale requests need a flat account and risk review.

programmes.comparisonWithBatch4: Same drawdown 0; batch 4 had no other axis → 3.5/5.

programmes.name: 2-Step Classic — FT+ Trader account
programmes.scope: Help article last updated 07.02.2026; funded FT+ Trader simulated live account.
programmes.scopeFr: Compte FT+ Trader du 2-Step Classic ; article du 07.02.2026.

drawdown.reason: 8% static maximum drawdown fixed on the initial balance, unaffected by profits.

payout.reason: First withdrawal 10 calendar days after account creation, then every 10 days; minimum 1% of the initial balance; 80% split. The 50% consistency gate is counted under consistency.

consistency.reason: Funded 50% best-day limit over the payout period; payout is blocked until met, not forfeited; resets after each payout.

trading.reason: 3% Symbol Loss Limit: any single instrument may not lose more than 3% of the prior-day balance (hard breach, applies on the funded account). Weekend holding allowed, no stop-loss requirement, news allowed per Risk Review Policy.

funded.reason: 4% daily drawdown hard limit; 30-day inactivity hard breach; scaling needs 20% new profit, one paid withdrawal, 2 months of activity per level and risk review.

programmes.comparisonWithBatch4: Same drawdown 1; batch 4 had no other axis → 3.5/5.

programmes.name: Instant — FT+ Trader account
programmes.scope: Help article last updated 08.12.2026; no evaluation.

drawdown.reason: 6% maximum loss trailing the balance high watermark until it reaches the initial balance.

payout.reason: Withdrawal from day 1 once in profit, minimum $50, then every 7 days; researcher contract and KYC required (ordinary).

consistency.reason: Consistency Rule article lists only the 2-Step Classic; the Instant article lists its rules without any consistency requirement.

trading.reason: No weekend holding: all trades must be closed by 4:30 pm EST on Friday or are closed by the system. News allowed per Risk Review Policy; no stop-loss requirement.

funded.reason: 6% daily drawdown on the higher of prior balance or equity remains a hard limit; 30-day inactivity hard breach; scale requests need a flat account and risk review.

programmes.name: Pass Now Pay Later — Funded stage
programmes.scope: PNPL article updated 09.24.2026; the Activation Accounts funded-rules article (09.18.2026) describes the same structure (fee to start, activation fee after passing, 6% equity trailing, 3% daily, 25% consistency).
programmes.scopeFr: PNPL, phase financée ; article du 24.09.2026, cohérent avec « Activation Accounts » (18.09.2026).

drawdown.reason: Funded 6% trailing on equity, following the equity high until it locks at the starting balance.

payout.reason: First payout after 10 trading days and at least 10 trading days between payouts; 3% minimum (PNPL page: minimum withdrawal 3% of balance; Activation page: 3% profit threshold, withdrawal from $50); 80% split. Moderate gate, no cap.

consistency.reason: 25% best-day limit at payout request (delays, does not cancel); below the 30% threshold of the rubric.

trading.reason: News trading, weekend holding and weekend trading allowed on the funded stage (subject to the FT+ news policy; the policy link on the page is a placeholder, and the Risk Review Policy states news trading is allowed).

funded.reason: Activation fee due after passing; 3% balance-based daily loss is a hard breach; no scaling.

programmes.comparisonWithBatch4: Batch 4: 0 / 0 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 = 1.5. Claude: 0 / 0.5 / 0 / 1 / 0.5 = 2.0. Differences: payout 0.5 (10-trading-day cycle and 3% gate are moderate, not severe forfeiture); consistency 0 (25% is below the rubric's 30% threshold); trading 1 (the page explicitly allows news and weekend holding). Reviewer decision needed.
